import hashlib,urllib.request,sys
for name,url,want in [('probe.py','https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahmardchain/momo/PLACEHOLDER/probe/probe.py','0fe543d31f36a24ad3c9e20a2e3f52a5c5f0cd24b293a6c15a99f43c5f891662'),('prompts.json','https://raw.githubusercontent.com/ahmardchain/momo/PLACEHOLDER/probe/prompts.json','c0ce9e12954d5e8721470bef8d02a4221f70351ba92f1137d821ac7d4cd5fd5f')]:
    b=urllib.request.urlopen(url,timeout=60).read()

    if got!=want: sys.exit(f'sha mismatch {name} {got}')
    open(name,'wb').write(b)
print('probe verified')
